results.llm_raw: {"say":"The goal needs the mined stream cut with the kept right half only; the two parallel belts that feed L3 are the only exposed 2-wide feeder pair, so I convert them in place into a cutter plus a trash on the waste side (the cutter's own outputs and the hub-side belts B84/B85/B135-B137 are not exposed as handles).","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B63","B64"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"left","confirm_waste":true}]},"why":"B63 and B64 are the two parallel cells feeding L3, the only 2-wide region available for the cutter; the left (waste) half goes into the trash so only RuRu---- continues."}]}

{"say":"The recipe is mine→cut(half=right)→hub, and the two documented miner chains feed L3 with raw RuRuRuRu; convert a straight segment of each into a cutter (wasting the left half) so the cut RuRu---- reaches the hub.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B112","B105","B97"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"left","confirm_waste":true}]},"why":"Cut M3's mined RuRuRuRu into the kept RuRu---- half on its way to L3."},{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B106","B98","B91"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"left","confirm_waste":true}]},"why":"Same cut on the parallel miner feed so all merged output to L3 is RuRu----."}]}

{"say":"The hub only receives full, uncut shapes from the balancer lines, so I'll convert the two parallel miner runs feeding L3 in place into a cutter plus waste trash, so the kept half continues toward the hub.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B63","B64","B69","B70","B81","B82"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"left","confirm_waste":true}]},"why":"Both parallel runs feed the same place (L3); handling them in one call gives the 2-wide region a cutter needs, cuts the miner output, and trashes the left half while the kept half flows onward."}]}

{"say":"The hub is fed uncut RuRuRuRu and delivers nothing; cut it to the goal half right before delivery and dump the waste half.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B135","B136","B137"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"left","confirm_waste":true}]},"why":"Recipe cuts RuRuRuRu to RuRu---- (kept on right, waste on left); converting the hub-feeding run inserts that cutter and trashes the left/waste half."}]}

{"say":"The M3 miner run carries the raw mined shape, so I drop a cutter onto that live run to turn it into the goal half-shape.","calls":[{"macro":"insert_machine","args":{"at":{"$ref":"B97","asCell":true},"machine":"cutter"},"why":"miner chain M3→L3 is the only visible live raw-shape run; adding the missing cutter there produces RuRu---- without building a new line"}]}

{"say":"Cut the two parallel miner runs that feed balancer L3 so the ore becomes the half shape before it reaches the hub.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B63","B64","B69","B70","B81","B82","B90","B91","B97","B98"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"left","confirm_waste":true}]},"why":"recipe needs a cutter on the ore line feeding the hub; the two parallel L3 input runs form a single 2-wide region, so they go in one call"}]}

{"say":"Both parallel lanes feeding L3 carry raw mined shapes into the hub; convert their top section into a cutter that keeps the right half and trashes the waste so the goal shape is delivered.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B63","B64","B69","B70","B81","B82"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"left","confirm_waste":true}]},"why":"The two adjacent runs (B63/B69/B81 and B64/B70/B82) feeding L3's two bottom inputs form one 2-wide region, so a cutter fits there and its kept right output continues down toward the hub while the left output is trashed."}]}

{"say":"The two parallel belt runs from the M3 miner into L3 carry mined RuRuRuRu; replacing a 2-wide block of them with a cutter turns that feed into cut RuRu without breaking the run.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$bbox_of":["B69","B70","B81","B82"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"}]},"why":"A cutter needs a 2-wide region and these two parallel straight runs form one; its bottom input takes the mined shape and its top outputs feed the existing belts toward L3."}]}
